data.gender_notes: Misba is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root s-b-' which means to lead or guide. Misba is a name of a companion or guide in life. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that Allah (swt) sends guides and helpers in the form of angels, prophets, and righteous individuals. Thus, Misba is a name that signifies one who is a guide or companion in life.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of guidance and companionship in the spiritual journey of life.
data.etymology: Misba belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Misba total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

It reflects the belief that Allah (swt) sends messengers, angels, and righteous individuals as guides and helpers in human life. Misba is a reminder that every person has the potential to be a guide and companion to others and that this role is an important part of our purpose in life.
